rationale: The Court is likely to hold that corporate-owned life-insurance proceeds are includable corporate assets at death under § 2031 and Treas. Reg. § 20.2031-2(f)(2), rejecting a categorical dollar-for-dollar “earmarking” exclusion. The majority will probably leave limited room for case-specific FMV adjustments only upon proof of a legally cognizable liability, while the dissent(s) emphasize that a willing buyer would net out a mandatory redemption obligation triggered by the same death event.
